## Decisions
- **Second AudioEngine per monitor, not device-switching** -> matches how Program monitor already works (its own master clock owns A/V sync); switching a single output between two engines would have meant re-deriving sync state on every tab switch. Required OpenAL multi-instance support as a side effect.
- **OpenAlAudioOutput: shared static lock + per-call "make current"** -> OpenAL's context-current state is process-global (not per-instance), so two `AudioEngine`s each with their own `OpenAlAudioOutput` need to coordinate. Chose the minimal fix (lock + re-activate-if-needed) over a bigger redesign.
- **Un-patched source-patch chip stays on its lane, dimmed** (not removed) -> matches Premiere; removing it read as "broken" with no way back. Required extending the persisted patch model with explicit Off flags rather than reusing a `-1` sentinel.
- **Fit to Fill is a 4-point Overwrite with an optional retime `speed`** threaded into the existing `ThreePointEdits.Build`, rather than a separate code path -> reuses all the carve/ripple/undo machinery; refused outside `SpeedRamp.MinSpeed`–`MaxSpeed` (1%–10000%).
- **Bin double-click focuses the Source monitor** (Premiere behavior) -> found the gap while a subagent wrote docs and had to document a workaround; fixed properly rather than leaving the workaround documented.
- **Docs subagent scoped to sprocket-docs only, explicitly told to leave the other person's uncommitted edits alone** -> those files (`projects-and-saving.md`, `file-menu.png`, `tools/README.md`, `open-recent.png`) are still sitting uncommitted in the docs repo; not part of this work.
- **No MCP tool added for Fit to Fill** -> left out of scope; existing `insert_edit`/`overwrite_edit`/`lift`/`extract` MCP rows are untouched (still ❌ for MCP docs specifically).
